title: Evolith Satellite Workspace Descriptor
description: JSON Schema for validating a satellite workspace (monorepo) evolith.workspace.yaml. A workspace declares the roots of N independently-governed satellite projects, each with its own evolith.yaml. Introduced by ADR-0109 (Multi-Project Satellite Governance). The per-project evolith.yaml schema (evolith-yaml.schema.json) is unchanged.

apiVersion.description: Evolith API version. Must be evolith.dev/v1.

kind.description: Kind of Evolith resource. Must be SatelliteWorkspace (distinguishes a workspace descriptor from a per-project Satellite manifest).

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the workspace.

projects.description: The authoritative set of satellite project roots in this workspace. Discovery is bounded to these declared paths; a manifest nested within another project's tree is prohibited (SVC-01). Every declared path must contain an evolith.yaml and every discovered evolith.yaml must be declared here (SVC-06).

name.description: Project identifier within the workspace. kebab-case, lowercase. Should match the project manifest's metadata.name at its path.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the project root (the directory containing that project's evolith.yaml). Must be relative (no leading slash) and must not traverse upward (no '..').
